meta_title: babu | Web development and digital transformation
meta_description: Consulting, administration and development of digital projects for the non-profit sector.
svc1_text: Design and deployment of every kind of web solution: from basic websites to advanced content management systems, virtual learning environments, CRM, and more.
svc2_text: Advisory and support services offering guidance, help and backing in implementing and systematizing processes, as well as in defining and shaping digital communication and fundraising strategies.
svc3_text: With special attention to serving those who work for the common good and to making this world a better place.
tech_text: There is no perfect tool, but there is an optimal way to adapt the best tool to each need
about_p1: As a freelance professional, I have supported more than ten organizations in modernizing their systems (CRM, web environments and infrastructure), improving their visibility and the efficiency of their internal management.
about_p2: Familiar with public administration and the private sector, and finally established as an independent entrepreneur, I have worked in teams with a wide range of professionals, learned about different working methodologies and contributed to projects of very varied kinds.
about_p3: A defender of free software and of its philosophy of using software for the common good, I work convinced that a job well done not only ensures that goals are met but also becomes a valuable investment in the future.
babuteca_link: Visit the babuteca. My corner for sharing.
form_description: Leave me a message and I'll get back to you shortly.
ck_meta_description: Information about the cookies and local storage used by babu.cat.
ck_p_controller: Francesc Bassas, owner of this website. You can reach him with the “Contact” button on the home page.
ck_p_what: They are small files that a website stores in your browser. This site only uses non-essential cookies (analytics), and only if you accept them. If you reject them, none are installed.
ck_gas_purpose: Keep track of the session state (only with consent).
ck_consent_purpose: Remember your cookie choice. It is not a cookie and never leaves your browser.
ck_h_withdraw: How to change or withdraw your consent
ck_p_withdraw1: You can change your decision at any time, as easily as you gave it:
ck_p_withdraw2: You can also delete cookies from your browser settings.
ck_p_google: If you accept analytics, Google Analytics receives usage data from the site (such as the page visited, the type of device or the IP address) and may process it on servers outside the European Economic Area, under the safeguards Google provides. More information in Google’s policy.
ck_p_form: The form is run by Formspree. What you type into it (email and message) is sent to Formspree only when you press “Send”, so I can reply to you; no script is loaded and no request is made to this service before that. See Formspree’s privacy policy.
ck_p_fonts: The fonts (Inter and JetBrains Mono) are hosted on this same site; no requests are made to Google Fonts or other third parties to load them.
ck_p_claims: If you believe your rights have not been respected, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or the Catalan Data Protection Authority.
form_ok: Thank you! I have received your message and will reply soon.
form_error: The message could not be sent. Please try again in a little while.
form_privacy: When you send the form, your data is processed through Formspree. More information.
